##### Project general facts

Azizi Tulip is an eclectic and attractive residential building offering a selection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, making it ideal for families looking to make an easy start to life. This charming development features simple aesthetics, minimalist design, and generous landscaped areas that create the perfect family home environment. The two and three-bedroom apartments are equipped with maid's rooms, while all residences feature walk-in balconies that extend living spaces outdoors.

The development offers a range of amenities designed to enhance everyday living, including generous landscaped areas that provide green spaces for relaxation and recreation. Residents can enjoy the convenience of fully furnished apartments that are ready to move into, ensuring a seamless transition to their new home. The community's thoughtfully designed spaces create a welcoming environment where families can thrive and make lasting memories.

Each residence features high-quality materials and fully fitted kitchens, creating living spaces that exude contemporary elegance and functionality. The apartments are fully furnished, offering residents immediate comfort and style without the hassle of furnishing. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a comfortable and stylish home environment that families will love.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in a modern and vibrant residential community that offers a high standard of living and a range of amenities for its residents. The community is conveniently located near major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The area's strategic positioning near the Jebel Ali Free Zone and the Dubai Expo site makes it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

The community is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle, with a range of amenities including parks, community centers, swimming pools, and sports courts. One of the unique features of the area is its emphasis on green spaces, with parks and landscaped areas spread throughout the community. Residents can enjoy a tranquil environment that promotes well-being and outdoor recreation.

The neighborhood offers convenient access to retail outlets and restaurants located within the community, providing residents with easy access to shopping and dining options. The location is in close vicinity to all major Dubai attractions and just minutes from Ibn Battuta Mall and major road networks. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of modern convenience, green living, and exceptional accessibility, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most accessible and convenient communities.
